text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘At the Doctor’ (डॉक्टर के पास)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘At the Doctor’ (Doctor ke paas). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘At the Doctor’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘fever’ मतलब बुखार। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘fever’ matlab bukhaar. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘fever’ means बुखार. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘doctor’ मतलब डॉक्टर। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘doctor’ matlab doctor. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘doctor’ means डॉक्टर. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘medicine’ मतलब दवाई। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘medicine’ matlab dawai. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘medicine’ means दवाई. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: Last week I had a fever.
Mummy took me to the doctor.
She checked my throat and said, "Open your mouth wide."
Then she gave me some medicine.
"Drink warm water and take rest," she said.
I took the medicine for three days.
Now I am fine and I can go to school again.

question.hi: डॉक्टर ने क्या पीने को कहा?
question.hinglish: Doctor ne kya peene ko kaha?
question.en: What did the doctor say to drink?
